name: Goliath Crane
description: Safe Build Engineering manufactures Goliath Cranes designed and manufactured in accordance with IS:3177 and IS:4137, with structural parts per IS:807. Applicable in construction, industry, yards, roadsides and other open areas, they are load tested to 125% and certified before dispatch ensuring maximum safety and reliability.
features: High quality structural assembly per IS:4301
Squirrel cage induction motors with fail safe brakes
Built-in brakes for hoisting, cross travel and long travel
